entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-10-01
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • `dotnet watch` drops an existing `DOTNET_STARTUP_HOOKS` (from the environment or the launch profile) instead of composing with it #56467
  • [AI discovered CI] dotnet.Tests.dll.18 aborts with core dump on Linux Helix #56465

PullRequests

Created

  • [WIP] Port signature verification changes from PR 56468 #56472
  • [WIP] Port signature verification changes from PR #56468 #56470
  • [WIP] Update MSI package signature verification in installer #56469
  • Verify MSI signature before manifest extraction. #56468
    Servicing-consider
  • Retain actionable Helix crash dumps #56466
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/11.0.1xx' => 'main' #56464
    sdk-diagnostic-docs-needed
  • [automated] Merge branch 'main' => 'release/dnup' #56463

Merged

  • [release/11.0.2xx] Preserve package satellite culture names when CultureInfo remaps them #56437
  • Prevent path pollution with local SDK testing #56456
  • [release/11.0.2xx] Backport Microsoft-internal CLI telemetry classification #56458
    Area-Telemetry
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0.4xx' => 'release/11.0.1xx' #56136

    Servicing-approved

  • Bump the github-actions group with 2 updates #56460
    dependencies, github_actions

Updated

  • Support solution filter (`.slnf`) inputs in `dotnet workload restore` #55599
  • Add an agent workflow to identify potentially stale references in Ignore attributes, TODOs, and workarounds #56405
  • Add BundledRuntimeAssetRuntimeIdentifiers to filter runtimes/ folder assets by RID allow-list #53140
    Partner request, Document for new feature, Area-NetSDK, stale, 11.0.1xx

  • Add dotnet sdk add and dotnet sdk remove commands #54577
    Area-CLI
  • Add incremental container archive publishing #55850
  • Port runtime PR dotnet/runtime#133111 R2R changes to SDK Crossgen tasks #56395
    Area-ReadyToRun, Area-WasmSdk, 12.0-preview1
  • fix(templates): conditionally omit package versions when CPM is active #54519
    Area-Common templates
  • Exclude scoped CSS assets from publish #54497
    Area-AspNetCore
  • Add net12 workload manifest authoring #56403
  • Plumb CancellationToken through all CLI commands for consistent Ctrl+C/SIGTERM behavior #56332
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/9.0.3xx' => 'release/10.0.1xx' #56297

    Test Debt
